notes.title: Mac version has been temporarily rolled back to 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Because of some game-breaking technical issues with version 1.0.9, we had to roll back to version 1.0.8 on macOS.
We are working on a proper version of 1.0.9 for the mac.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and sidebar update
notes.notes:
Updated the sidebar to show platform icons for game links
 Added graphics and default mapping of the DualSense controller on Windows machines.
 Fixed all-white skybox visible when flying into the abyss in one of the levels with Dingbot

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Version 1.0.8

This patch addresses some issues regarding saving of data, that could lead to a softlocked gamestate if the player hard exits the game inbetween certain stages of gamestate and saving.


 The arena console will no longer save twice after the first engagement, to avoid broken save states.
 Updated logic on certain gameobjects in many scenes, so that they don't save too early and create a temporary broken save.
 The banner with links now show up-to-date content from Rain.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.6
notes.notes:
Accessibility / QOLI (Quality of Life Improvements)

 Increased various text sizes in Game Menu to improve readability.

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.5
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - v1.0.5

Bug & Issue Fixes

 The Crypt Clank Boss attacks now sync up correctly on every difficulty settings.
 Fixed minor spelling issue.
 Fixed issue where you could land on broken rails in Art Storage.
 Fixed issue with "End of Act" UI not queueing correctly.
 Fixed issue where Agatha could jump down on some Air Vents and get stuck.
 Removed old Debug Warning.
 Added missing colliders to certain walls in Great Cog.
 Added Missing Collider in Lucrezias Study.
 Pressing the "Pause" button on controller will now correctly close the "Load Game" window

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Accessibility / QOLI (Quality of Life Improvements)

 Jumping down from ledges has been adjusted to make it a little better for everyone.


Bug & Issue Fixes

 The "A Perfect Moment in Time" achievement can now be unlocked correctly
 Tarvek is feeling a little better, and won't write dialogue over other lines of dialogue.
 A cutscene issue within Phosphorous Gate has been fixed.
 Certain pistons will stay behind walls as they're supposed to.
 Hiding inside staircases are no longer possible (clanks reported that it felt unfair)
 Fixed certain text typos.
 A certain treasure canister will no longer hold Dingbot back.
 Arena Console has been adjusted to use a linear time format for best clear time evaluation.
 Should Agatha use the death ray within an Arena-Challenge, it will now be recharged accordingly after exiting the challenge.
 RollerClanks have gotten a better understanding of collision with stairs in the vault levels.
 Collision within the arena has been adjusted to keep any dropped item from clipping through.
 Fixed some issues regarding Zola's animations.
